Frontend Engineer
Marshgrass Labs
Charleston, SC (Hybrid)

About Marshgrass Labs
We make field-data apps for coastal research teams. Our small product team ships every week.

This is a hybrid role with three days a week in our downtown office.

Responsibilities:
• Build new screens in React and TypeScript
• Work with designers in Figma to refine flows
• Write tests with Jest and Cypress

Qualifications:
• 3+ years of professional JavaScript or TypeScript
• Solid HTML and CSS, including accessibility basics
• Experience with React
• Git and code review habits
• Collaborative and curious, comfortable with feedback

Preferred qualifications:
• React Native
• GraphQL
• Node.js on the server side

Salary range: $95,000 to $120,000.
